title: Figure 12. Detection Photons Sent to Locations That are Less Affected by Noise (Li-Effect)
description: Axis diagram with z vertical, y horizontal (N to S) and x diagonal, showing "Poynting Vector or Detection Photons (PPF)" directed along the x-axis away from the "Very Noisy (BPF)" region, with "GW & EM Synchro-Resonant" waves along z. Annotations at both ends of the x-axis read "Signal (PPF) and Noise (BPF) have very different physical behavior PPF > BPF at this end of x-axis". Caption: "Figure 12. Detection Photons Sent to Locations That are Less Affected by Noise".
